headlines.title: 이달 1~20일 수출 435억 달러 … 조업일수 감소에도 ‘역대 최대’
headlines.summary: ■ 전년대비 23.5% 증가 설연휴에 조업 2.5일 줄었는데 반도체 수출액 134% 넘게 늘어 설날 연휴로 인한 조업일수 감소에도 불구하고 수출 증가세는 꺾이지 않았다. 반도체가 전체 수출을 강하게 끌어올리면서 매월 1∼20일 기준 최대 수출액을 갈아치웠다.

headlines.title: 이달 1 ∼ 20일 수출 435억달러 ‘ 역대최대 ’… 반도체 134%↑
headlines.summary: 일평균 수출도 47.3% 급증 수입 11.7%↑, 무역흑자 49억弗 이달 1∼20일 우리 수출액이 설 연휴에도 불구 430억달러를 돌파하면서 같은 기간 역대 최대 실적을 기록했다. 인공지능(AI) 수요 확대로 ‘슈퍼사이클’을 타고 있는 반도체 수출이 두 배이상 뛰면서 전체 증가세를 주도했다.

headlines.title: 2월 1~20일 수출 435억 달러 … 역대 최대, 반도체가 이끌었다
headlines.summary: 핵심요약 전년比 23.5%↑…조업일수 줄었지만 일평균 47% 급증 무역수지 49억 달러 흑자…대중·대미 수출 모두 확대 연합뉴스 이달 1~20일 한국 수출액이 430억 달러를 넘어서며 같은 기간 기준 역대 최대 실적을 기록했다. '슈퍼 사이클' 호황을 맞은 반도체 수출이 전체 증가세를 주도했다.

headlines.title: 작년 조세부담률 18%대 … 3년 만에 반등에도 OECD 최하위권
headlines.summary: 국세 374조·지방세 115조 이상 걷힐 듯…법인·소득세 동반 증가 영향 38개국 중 32위 수준…80조 원대 조세지출·낮은 실효세율 때문 ⓒ 뉴스1 윤주희 디자이너 (세종=뉴스1) 임용우 기자 = 지난해 국내총생산(GDP) 대비 세금 수입 비율인 '조세부담률'이 18%대를 기록하며 3년 만에 반등할 것으로 추산됐다.

headlines.title: 서울 매물 한달새 19% 증가 … 1년 전보단 27% 감소
headlines.summary: 다주택자 압박에 한달새 매물 증가 전년보다 매물 증가, 강남구가 유일 서초·송파 3~20%대 ↓…효과 제한적 정부 “집값 안정” vs 일부 “일시 효과” 정부의 전방위적인 다주택자 압박으로 최근 서울 강남구에선 매물이 늘어나는 등 시장 상황의 변화가 감지된다. 그러나 서울 전체를 볼 땐 1년전보다 매물이 줄었다.

headlines.title: ' 규제지역 아파트 ' 다주택자 대출 회수 초읽기…집값 영향은
headlines.summary: 금융위, 서울·수도권 아파트 다주택자 대출 연장 제한 LTV 0% 적용 속 '단계적 상환' 병행 검토 매물 증가·집값 안정 효과 불투명 금융당국이 서울·수도권 등 규제지역 내 아파트를 보유한 다주택자의 대출 만기 연장 금지를 추진한다. 만기가 도래하는 대출의 연장이나 대환을 신규 대출과 동일한 수준으로 묶어, 사실상 '대출 회수'에 나서는 것이 핵심이다.

headlines.title: ‘ 대출 조이고, 임대는 공공 ’… 생계형 임대사업자 “ 퇴로 절실 ”
headlines.summary: 비거주 다주택자 대출 강화 움직임 임대사업자 35%, 수입 없는 고령층 대출 규제 일괄 적용 땐 생계 위협 정부, 지역·유형 등 ‘핀셋규제’ 할듯 다주택자를 향한 대출 규제 강화 움직임이 본격화하면서, ‘생계형 임대사업자’의 퇴로를 열어줘야 한다는 목소리가 나오고 있다.

key_headlines.title: Government Holds Emergency Market Review, Cites Persistent Risks and Calls for Vigilance
key_headlines.summary: The Korean government convened an emergency market situation review, with First Vice Minister Lee Hyung-il presiding, acknowledging the presence of persistent risk factors requiring heightened vigilance.

key_headlines.title: Government: US Reciprocal Tariff Invalidation Has Limited Financial Market Impact, Vows to Protect Export Conditions
key_headlines.summary: The government assessed that the US Supreme Court's ruling invalidating reciprocal tariffs would have a limited impact on Korea's financial markets but committed to protecting export conditions and the balance of national interests.

key_headlines.title: Government to Closely Monitor US Trends to Safeguard National Interests
key_headlines.summary: First Vice Minister Lee Hyung-il stated that the government would meticulously monitor US developments, including the maintenance of product-specific tariffs and the initiation of Section 301 investigations, to ensure no damage to Korea's profit balance.

key_headlines.title: US to Maintain Tariffs Despite IEEPA Block, Utilizing Section 232 and 301 Laws
key_headlines.summary: Despite the US Federal Supreme Court curbing reciprocal tariff imposition under the IEEPA, the Trump administration affirmed its intent to maintain tariff policies by leveraging other legal frameworks like Section 232 and Section 301.

key_headlines.title: Government Acknowledges Limited Market Impact from US Tariff Ruling but Urges Continued Vigilance
key_headlines.summary: The Ministry of Economy and Finance reported that while the US ruling on reciprocal tariffs had a limited immediate impact on financial markets, the government would maintain 24-hour monitoring and vigilance due to ongoing external risks.

sections.Hot Economy News: The Korean government held emergency market review meetings, chaired by First Vice Minister Lee Hyung-il, emphasizing the need for heightened vigilance due to persistent risk factors. Specifically, the government assessed the US Supreme Court's ruling invalidating reciprocal tariffs, concluding its financial market impact was limited but committing to protect export conditions and national interests. Despite the ruling, the US administration announced it would maintain tariffs through other legal avenues like Sections 232 and 301. The Korean government pledged continuous 24-hour market monitoring to respond to potential additional US tariffs and investigations.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The Bank of Korea's Monetary Policy Committee is widely expected to freeze its key interest rate in February, influenced by a sustained high exchange rate and the US FOMC's likely decision to hold rates. While the won-dollar exchange rate saw a slight dip, the high-exchange rate trend continues to impact BOK decisions. Federal Reserve officials presented differing views on the impact of AI on employment and monetary policy, with some like Lisa Cook suggesting that AI-driven unemployment might not be effectively addressed by traditional demand-side monetary policies, even if productivity rises. Conversely, others argue that AI's impact on employment might be overstated, highlighting the ongoing debate within the Fed about AI's macroeconomic implications.
sections.Financial Markets: A significant majority (99%) of bond market professionals anticipate the Bank of Korea to freeze its key interest rate in February, driven by persistent high exchange rates and the US FOMC's inclination to hold rates. Bond funds have seen their assets under management fall below 100 trillion won, possibly due to a strong stock market rally and diminished expectations for immediate US rate cuts. The KOSPI index achieved a new historical closing high of 6,083.86, signaling robust performance in the Korean stock market. The 'Pilseung Korea Fund' by NH-Amundi Asset Management was recognized for its exceptional performance, recording a 113.01% return last year, significantly outperforming the KOSPI. The ETF market is experiencing rapid growth, becoming a dominant force in the stock market, though concerns remain regarding the high volatility of leveraged/inverse ETFs and currency risks associated with overseas asset ETFs.
sections.Industry & Technology: A recent report indicates that South Korea lags behind China in several advanced industries, including robotics, electric vehicles, batteries, and autonomous driving, with semiconductors being the main exception. The government is engaging with Korean battery and semiconductor companies investing in the US to address challenges related to workforce entry and residence. Samsung SDI is proactively tackling the electric vehicle battery industry downturn by focusing on securing future technologies and expanding into new markets like energy storage systems (ESS), robotics, and defense. Proposed reforms to electricity tariff structures are expected to reduce costs for the semiconductor and automotive sectors while increasing them for the steel industry, including temporary weekend discounts for industrial and EV charging to enhance grid stability.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon accused the central government of impeding the city's redevelopment and reconstruction projects, suggesting political motivations related to fears of Seoul's conservative shift. He highlighted that government policies, especially loan restrictions, are delaying the planned supply of 310,000 new homes by 2031. Properties located in 'hak-sek-won' (school zone) areas within the capital region are experiencing high demand and robust subscription rates, proving to be relatively resilient during real estate downturns. However, some newly launched apartment complexes, such as 'The Sharp Bundang Centro,' faced significant uncontracted units despite strong initial competition, leading to re-subscription calls due to loan restrictions and negative market outlooks. In Seoul's affluent Gangnam district, there are mixed signals with multi-homeowners listing properties for quick sale at reduced prices ahead of impending capital gains tax changes, while other transactions still occur at high price points.
sections.International Economy: The US has implemented a 15% global tariff, effective today, with President Trump threatening even higher tariffs against nations that challenge the ruling. This action follows the US Supreme Court's ruling against reciprocal tariffs under the IEEPA, with the Trump administration now using other legal frameworks like Sections 232 and 301 to maintain its tariff policies. The Federal Reserve's Monetary Policy Committee (FOMC) is widely expected to hold interest rates, with mixed economic indicators contributing to this cautious stance. Some Fed officials anticipate that short-term policy rates could remain frozen until well into 2027 due to prevailing economic conditions. Separately, Bitcoin has fallen below the $65,000 mark, prompting discussions about a potential prolonged 'crypto winter' in the digital asset market.
sections.AI & Economy: Accelera AI, an edge AI chip startup, successfully raised $250 million in investment for its Metis product, which boasts high computational power with minimal energy consumption, ideal for battery-powered devices. There's a growing sentiment that leveraging AI merely for cost reduction is insufficient; true economic innovation requires a fundamental shift in outdated organizational cultures to significantly boost productivity. While the semiconductor and AI industries demonstrate strong growth, domestic demand, small and medium-sized enterprises, and self-employed businesses are struggling, highlighting a disparity in the economic benefits derived from AI advancements.
sections.Others: Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon believes the new Han River bus project will be instrumental in developing a unique Seoul brand, projecting it will quickly achieve financial independence through affordable fares and advertising revenue. The government plans to invest 45.9 billion won this year to support the pre-emption of international standards in advanced industries, including AI, to boost exports. HDC Hyundai EP appointed Shin Woo-chul, a veteran in advanced materials, as its new CEO. The K-beauty ODM sector is flourishing, driven by strong export performance, particularly to North America, although it faces potential uncertainty from a proposed US 15% global tariff; however, short-term impact is expected to be limited by price adjustments and increased local production. The Korea Railroad Research Institute (KRRI) celebrated its 30th anniversary, recognized for transforming Korea from an importer to an exporter of high-speed rail technology, with a notable export success to Uzbekistan in 2024.
